notes.title: Seduce You Into Playing Seduction
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38477796/80875517b91c618020efdad45d59e402f1bd4bc1.jpg[/img]

《Seduction》is launching today after a year plus of development. It is a unique game which you play the role of a monk and his journey into the unknown realm. Parts of the game is inspired by 'Journey to the west' tale.

The game is available in English.

Thank you all for the wait and follow, please do enjoy the game :)

P.S If encounter any bugs or issues, please go to the discussion forum.

notes.title: Seduction is going to release at Oct.9 2021
notes.notes:
Seduction is going to release at October 9, 2021, 14:00 (UTC+8). If you missed the Tokyo Game Show, please check the video below:

[previewyoutube=ljzVUuN_p2A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Seduction is a 2d horror adventure puzzle game. Lee has to survive in the dark realm and to reveal the truth of the temple buried in the temple.

Seduction is a project that I have a lot fun making due to the unique playable character and setting.  Playing as a Chinese monk is something we usually don't see a lot in video games as well as exploring concepts that is intriguing and different. I hope players can simply enjoy the game and the journey. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Announcement of 'Seduction'
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38477796/a0082a0a126a9383802e84e3f954bf16961508c0.jpg[/img]

The first announcement for 'Seduction', a 2d puzzle & horror game about a monk facing a vengeful spirit from the past. The game is inspired by Chinese mythology and stories.
